items.lede: Amazon hasn't made an Echo with a 3.5mm port in six years.
items.title: Amazon kills Alexa’s ability to control Echo speakers' AUX input

items.lede: If you've been using an older Amazon Echo device as a speaker through its 3.5mm aux input, Alexa voice commands to play or pause from line in may stop working. Ars Technica points to this Reddit poster claiming they received a message from Amazon about the change, which the company has confirmed. According to Amazon […]
